validation.cmd:
$env:UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT='private-input/4b06809c9ca2d51ba83b'
$env:PYTHONPATH='private-input/0d2012363c94bcf4a831'
$env:OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='4'
$env:OMP_NUM_THREADS='4'
$env:POLARS_MAX_THREADS='4'

$env:PYTHONPATH += ';private-input/f0b09867706f786297b8;private-input/e5ce4022c3bb83280dee'
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'
uv run --offline --frozen --no-sync python -B -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; from artifacts.rp4_v4_code.report_v4_checked import read_json,read_csv,verify_receipt_identity,verify_results; from artifacts.rp4_code.evaluate import sha256; p=Path('artifacts/rp4_v4_b3_rv15'); r=read_json(p/'receipt.json'); verify_receipt_identity(r,15,'confirmation'); assert r['exit_code']==0 and all(c['exit_code']==0 and sha256(Path(c['log']))==c['log_sha256'] for c in r['commands']); assert all(sha256(Path(k))==v for k,v in r['artifacts_sha256'].items()); s=read_json(p/'summary.json'); verify_results(s,read_csv(p/'session_losses.csv'),15,'confirmation'); old=read_json(Path('artifacts/rp4_v3_b3/summary.json')); assert (s['N_sessions'],s['N_origins'])==(old['N_sessions'],old['N_origins'])==(25,9750); assert s['executed_origins_by_asset']==old['executed_origins_by_asset']; print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS_RV15_CONFIRMATION_CLOSED_RECEIPTS_MEANS_SEQUENCE_N_ASSET_PARITY','summary_sha256':sha256(p/'summary.json'),'csv_sha256':sha256(p/'session_losses.csv'),'contrasts':[{k:c[k] for k in ['family','contrast','estimate','ci_low','ci_high','p_raw','p_for_decision','hypothesis_status','qlike_reduction_percent']} for c in s['contrasts']]}))"
exit $LASTEXITCODE
